note: GET of a password-protected video with a wrong x-peertube-video-password header: the only 403 an anonymous client gets for a video. Shape from PeerTube develop: server/core/middlewares/validators/shared/videos.ts (403, ServerErrorCode.INCORRECT_VIDEO_PASSWORD) and middlewares/error.ts res.fail.

body.detail: Incorrect video password. Access to the video is denied
